Task 1 "Set up project structure and design tokens" is complete.

**What was created:**

- `assets/fonts/` and `assets/images/` directories
- `index.html` — full semantic skeleton with `<header>`, `<main>` containing all five sections (`#hero`, `#about`, `#skills`, `#projects`, `#contact`), and `<footer>`; Google Fonts Oswald link with `font-display: swap` included
- `style.css` — `:root` custom properties covering the P5 Palette (`--color-red`, `--color-black`, `--color-white`, `--color-gold`), typography tokens (`--font-heading`, `--font-body`), spacing scale (`--space-xs` through `--space-xl`), animation timing variables, plus baseline reset and styles for every section, button, nav, and animation pattern defined in the design document
- `main.js` — ES6 module with empty class stubs (`NavController`, `AnimationController`, `FormValidator`) and a `DOMContentLoaded` initialisation block; classes are exported for testing in later tasks

All requirements 1.1, 1.2, 1.5, 10.4, 10.5 are satisfied: P5 Palette applied, Oswald font loaded with swap, `font-display: swap` present, semantic HTML structure in place, and the Vanilla Stack used exclusively.
